card.name: Digits inside counts and percentages
card.fires_on: Individual digits partway through numbers in clinical data, especially the second or third digit of a count in a fraction such as (25/35) or a level such as 20 mg/L. It also fires weakly on a few stray spots like a space between numbers.

modes.label: Digits in fractions
modes.description: A digit inside the numerator or denominator of an n/N patient count after a percentage.
modes.example: Approximately 71% (25/<<3>>5) of patients with adrenal insuff

modes.label: Digits in lab values
modes.description: A digit inside a measured level or reference range with units.
modes.example: 56 times the upper therapeutic level of <<2>>0 mg/L

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese and Japanese words, so there is no clear output effect.
